source_file.description: Path to the nf_conntrack file or data source.

input_stream.description: If set, reads from standard input. Use '-' to indicate stdin.

no_resolve.description: If true, do not resolve IPs to hostnames or ports to service names (-n).

no_header.description: If true, suppress the output table header (-o).

wide_table.description: If true, widen address columns to 40 chars (-x).

wide_table_ipv6.description: If true, widen address columns for full IPv6 specs (-X).

wide_table_width.description: Custom width for address columns, overriding -X if > 0 (-Xwidth).

show_gateway.description: If true, add the Gateway Address column (-G).

only_snat.description: If true, only show Source NAT connections (-S).

only_dnat.description: If true, only show Destination NAT connections (-D).

only_local.description: If true, only show connections involving local addresses (-L).

only_remote.description: If true, only show non-NAT connections not involving local addresses (-R).

sources.description: List of source addresses or hostnames to filter for (-s).

destinations.description: List of destination addresses or hostnames to filter for (-d).

gateways.description: List of gateway addresses to filter for (-g).

protocols.description: List of layer 4 protocols to filter for (e.g., TCP, UDP) (-p).

sort_column.description: Column to sort output by: src, dst, src-port, dst-port, state, gate, gate-port.
